Chapter 843: Chapter 34 Breakthrough (Please Subscribe)

Outskirts of the nine-story Black Tower.

Lin Yuan strode forward.

Following the transformation of the Magic Jade Mark, in addition to being able to sense the exact coordinates of this Demon Jade Space,

Lin Yuan also obtained partial authority over this Demon Jade Space; for instance, if he wished, he could easily appear at any location.

However, in the past when he entered the Demon Jade Space, he always did so by walking to the front of the nine-story Black Tower.

Lin Yuan was accustomed to this, so he also chose to walk over this time.

“Have you become a Demon Jade Tower Member?” Statue Shen Ji had been waiting for a long time and looked at Lin Yuan with a complex gaze.

Even he had not considered the possibility of Lin Yuan becoming a Tower Member.

This was mainly because the Magic Jade Tower’s headquarters had collapsed, and the foundation carrying all the demonic evolutionary pathways had been destroyed.

Under these circumstances, the only way to fully comprehend all demonic evolutionary pathways would be to deduce them from the bodies of twelve-tiered Magic Jade Tower members.

But this was extremely difficult.

Comprehend all demonic evolutionary pathways from the bodies of twelve-tiered strong ones? For those alive at the twelfth tier, it was still manageable as they could contain their oppressive aura, but the remnants of the fallen at the twelfth tier would still unleash the intangible pressure of their spirit and will.

This kind of spirit and will pressure, to those of the twelfth tier’s same level, might not be anything significant, but to lifeforms below the twelfth tier, it was utterly impossible to withstand.

Incapable of withstanding such pressure, let alone to thoroughly comprehend all the demonic evolutionary pathways.

So, even though Statue Shen Ji was aware of Lin Yuan’s extraordinary talent, he never entertained the thought that the latter could become a Tower Member.

This was mainly because this path had been essentially severed with the disappearance of the Moyu Tower Master.

“Lucky, I guess,” Lin Yuan said with a smile.

“Lucky?” Statue Shen Ji was speechless.

Even during the Magic Jade Tower’s most prosperous times, Tower Members were exceedingly rare; there would be no more than a hundred members from the same era.

Every Demon Jade Tower Member possessed the potential to become twelve-tiered; how could this be merely chalked up to luck?

Direct Disciples taken on by the Demonic Jade Tower Master were being groomed to become the supreme strong, and likewise, Tower Members also held the potential to achieve that supreme status.

Not to mention Lin Yuan’s means of becoming a Demon Jade Tower Member, which was countless times more difficult than those before him, even more challenging than becoming a Direct Disciple of the Moyu Tower Master.

“You were born in the wrong era,” Statue Shen Ji said with a sigh after a long time.

If he were in the era when the Magic Jade Tower was at its peak… even if not at its peak, as long as a twelfth-tiered strong one was present to uphold the Tower, Lin Yuan would have received the Tower’s full support in his cultivation.

But now?

Even though he had forcibly become a Demon Jade Tower Member, what Lin Yuan received was far less than before, and he was even devoid of the various benefits that came with being a Tower Member.

“I think it’s quite alright.”

Lin Yuan shook his head. He had already reaped many benefits from this Demon Jade Space, and being in the Magic Jade Tower’s heyday might not necessarily have been a good thing.

“Let’s talk about serious matters.”

Statue Shen Ji waved his right hand, and a phantom screen appeared in front of Lin Yuan.

It was the reward for becoming a Tower Member.

Previously, when Lin Yuan became a core member of the Magic Jade Tower, he obtained the right to choose from various Secret Techniques.

Now that he was a Tower Member, the rewards were even more numerous and of greater value.

“I’ll pick later.”

Lin Yuan glanced over it and spoke.

He was on the verge of entering the eleventh tier, and the rewards on the screen weren’t of much immediate help to him at the moment; it was better to save them until after he reached the eleventh tier and choose based on his needs then.

Currently, Lin Yuan was not sure of the extent of the transformation he would undergo after stepping into the eleventh tier, so he decided it was best to wait and see.

“No problem.”

Statue Shen Ji nodded.

Now that Lin Yuan was a Tower Member, his authority over this Demon Jade Space was only slightly less than Shen Ji’s.

“Members falling into this space also have authority, right?” Lin Yuan asked after carefully sensing for a while.

“Yes,” Statue Shen Ji said, “You can specify the identity, racial bloodline, and so on for ordinary members descending into this space.”

The hierarchy of the Magic Jade Tower was strict. To the elevated Tower Members, the future of ordinary members was but a word away.

“Then I specify that only beings from my human civilization can descend into this Demon Jade Space from now on,” Lin Yuan immediately said.

So far, no Alien Strong Ones had become ordinary members of the Magic Jade Tower and thus descended into the Demon Jade Space.

But one could never be too cautious, as those Alien Strong Ones were also contemplating the demonic evolutionary pathways in their bodies.

Looking at the long-term perspective, it was possible for them to become ordinary members of the Magic Jade Tower.

Thus, Lin Yuan simply cut off this possibility.

If they couldn’t enter this Demon Jade Space, those Alien Strong Ones, even if they became ordinary members of the Magic Jade Tower, would gain no benefits.

It would be a fruitless effort.

“Done.”

Statue Shen Ji closed his eyes and opened them again shortly.

For him, filtering the identity of ordinary members descending into this Demon Jade Space was all too simple.

“Next, I want to try tackling the seventh level.”

Lin Yuan looked up at the nine-story Black Tower in front of him and slowly said.

The seventh level of the Black Tower was something only a twelfth-tiered strong one could hope to overcome.

Before the tenth traversal, Lin Yuan wouldn’t even dare to think about it.

Grasping the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule at the Second Realm? Just getting past the sixth level was tough, let alone the seventh?

But now, Lin Yuan had comprehended the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule at the Sixth Realm, firmly standing at the domain of the twelfth tier.
